notes:
I found two free options in Halton Hills for a toddler. I didn't confirm that either one is open on a particular day.

- **Kids & Me:** Halton Region's page lists it Thursdays 10:30 a.m. to 12 p.m. at the Acton library branch. That page doesn't state an age range or a price. The library's own page calls Kids & Me a free weekly drop-in for babies and children up to 6, but it gives no day or time. I didn't use that page as the source.
- **Links2Care EarlyON:** Links2Care says the programs are free and drop-in, for children from birth to age 6 with a parent or caregiver. Their current schedule is further down their page and I didn't read it, so I haven't listed a day or time. The Acton and Georgetown locations appear in a health-line directory, not on Links2Care's own page.

I left out the Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre preschool drop-in, because it costs $15.
